completion_matrix.description: Clean checkout installs with documented dependencies
completion_matrix.reason: Fresh isolated Python 3.12 environment installed the exact copied source snapshot successfully; no raw data or .env copied. This is scoped installation evidence, not remote CI.

completion_matrix.description: Documented fixture tests pass in an independently reproduced clean environment
completion_matrix.reason: All 53 tests in the frozen post-remediation snapshot passed independently; original snapshot 46 passed. Later five controller tests passed. Counts overlap and do not prove scientific completeness.

completion_matrix.description: Registered source inventory verifies; nonredistributable data have documented reacquisition/import paths
completion_matrix.reason: All 90 local registered byte/ZIP checks pass, but complete documented reacquisition/import paths, exact upstream releases and rights for nonredistributable/manual inputs are not demonstrated; local hashes alone do not meet clause 1.

completion_matrix.description: Credential/raw-data exclusions and fail-closed inference configuration are independently checked
completion_matrix.reason: Observed .env ignored/untracked, mode 0600, current tracked source scan had no credential-pattern matches, actual nonsecret budgets are disabled/zero; strict enabled guard/cancellation probes passed after fixes. Rotation/real credentials remain G5, not certified.

completion_matrix.description: Frozen real race sample, official candidates, geography and historical crosswalks are verified
completion_matrix.reason: No independently accepted real race/ballot/geography manifest in audited snapshot; later E01 worker artifacts need separate review.

completion_matrix.description: Genuine historical statistical baselines evaluated under frozen sample and input rules
completion_matrix.reason: Audited sealed forecast outputs are DEMO; genuine retrospective worker implementation not yet independently validated.
